newsitem.title: USA: Surge in technology stocks pushes Nasdaq higher.
newsitem.headline: Surge in technology stocks pushes Nasdaq higher.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite Index rose for the second day as investors, optimistic about holiday PC sales, jumped at technology stocks.
The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 19.04, or 1.50 percent, to 1285.36. The Dow gained 38 to close unofficially at 6347 and the long bond fell 15/32 to yield 6.70 percent.
"Nasdaq was up across the board. Techs got a burst, but I'm not overly impressed by this rally. It (the market) has been all over the spectrum lately," one trader said.
Intel Corp swelled 5-3/4 to 135-3/4, leading Nasdaq's most active list.
Dell Computer Corp added 3-1/8 56-1/2, Microsoft Corp gained 2-3/4 to 82-5/8 and 3Com Corp increased 5-1/8 to 77-1/2.
The technology rally was sparked, in part, by positive comments from a Soundview analyst about Compaq Computer Corp, which is traded on the New York Stock Exchange, traders said.

Wednesday's jump comes just two days after investors dumped technology stocks on fears of dismal personal computer sales. Gainers beat losers by 2404 to 1866 on total volume of about 634 million shares.
